thread:
deploy-bot: Starting staged geo cutover: control-plane change rollout id=gc-2026-03-15-09, targets=eu,apac,latency-optimized routing enabled, canary=5% :rocket:

 dylan (oncall): getting pages — big spike 502s from EU edge starting ~2m after canary. seeing increased error-rate for some enterprise tenants. paged oncall.

 incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED - severity=P2 - incident_id=INC-20260315-867. Pager escalation sent to dylan, sarah. Use #incidents for coordination.

 dylan (oncall): Anyone else seeing TCP reset counts on eu-edge?

 sarah: yes, tcp resets and 502s. quick glance: control-plane reports inconsistent route table versions across eu-edge fleet (some nodes still on v3, others pulled v4).

 maria: hmm, control-plane propagation should be synced. could be the patch to rollout propagation TTL. checking control-plane logs now.

 ops_lead: tl;dr — partial edge nodes flipped to new routing that sends traffic to the new model cluster (model-v2) and a subset of backends are returning 503 because cert pins weren't applied. some clients hit old backends, others new -> inconsistent failures.

 jack: customer-success pinged — at least 3 enterprise customers reporting failed requests in EU. unclear if data-plane or auth.

 customer-success: confirmed impact — 3 customers with high request rates, started noticing at t+3m. they're seeing 502/503s. logged as support tickets CS-4221..CS-4223.

 dylan (oncall): can we pause the rollout? is there a kill-switch for the control-plane change?

 sarah: yes — we can flip rollout policy to rollback or set region weight to 0 for v4 routes. pref: kill the feature flag that enables v4 routing in EU, that should force nodes to fall back. executing now.

deploy-bot: roll_policy_update(command): set_rollout_weight(gc-2026-03-15-09, eu, 0) 

 maria: applied. publishing new config to control-plane. propagation started.

 dylan (oncall): monitoring...error-rate down on eu-edge?

 (small pause)

 maria: delay in edge reaction — some edge caches had the old routing cached for TTL=45s so we still see a tail of errors. good sign: 60s after kill-switch median 5xx% dropped from 12% -> 1.8%.

 incident-bot: NOTE: rollback completed for eu region gc-2026-03-15-09 at 2495556849.

 ops_lead: we have partial customer impact window ~3m — estimate ~1.2k failed requests total across impacted tenants. recommend post-incident follow-up with CS and small credit.

 jack: did we trigger automated fallback to v1 for older backends? any data loss?

 sarah: no data loss. requests failed, not accepted. retries will be client-initiated. fallback to v1 wasn't required because rollback restored v3 routing, which is the stable path.

 dylan (oncall): root cause hypothesis: control-plane rollout pushed config referencing new TLS pins and backend hostnames before backend certs were deployed to all model-v2 pods; combined with inconsistent route table propagation TTL resulted in mixed populations.

 maria: logs:

```
control-plane: applied config gc-2026-03-15-09 -> routes: eu:v4, apac:v3
edge-node-142: route_version=4 -> proxy->model-v2.cluster.svc:443 (tls: pin A)
model-v2-pod-7: cert=pending
proxy: upstream_connect_error: connection reset by peer
```

 ops_lead: mitigation checklist executed: kill-switch, rollback weight, notify CS, start postmortem. Next: coordinate hotfix to ensure backend cert rollout completes before control-plane flips.

 dylan (oncall): handing off to sarah for incident lead and postmortem. I'm going offline for next 30m; reach me via pager if anything spikes.

 sarah: taking incident lead. will gather timeline, metrics, and config diffs. tagging infra and release-engineering.

 incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED - owner=sarah - status=mitigated - severity=P2 - timeline_started=2495556789 - mitigated_at=2495556849

 maria: immediate next steps: 1) run a passive audit to find any other regions with mismatched route_version != control-plane target; 2) add extra preflight check in rollout pipeline that verifies backend certs and DNS SRV records for new routes; 3) reduce edge cache TTLs for rolling changes we push to control-plane.

 ops_lead: agree. also add a staged canary check that verifies TLS handshake success on sample subset before weight increases.

 customer-success: we'll draft customer comms: brief incident summary, impacted window, and credits. assigning CS->maria to confirm numbers.

 sarah: capturing action items in INC-20260315-867. assigning owners: maria (preflight checks + follow-up deploy), ops_lead (run fleet audit), customer-success (cust comms), jack (postmortem doc).

 dylan (oncall): thanks everyone. I'm available on pager if re-escalation needed. :thumbsup:

 sarah: wrapping up — final note: no fallback to global kill-switch needed; targeted region kill-switch worked. we'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

 incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) - final_status=rollback_completed - followup=postmortem_scheduled - incident_id=INC-20260315-867

 jack: will prepare a timeline and include raw control-plane diffs and edge metrics.

 customer-success: customers notified, two asked for immediate credits. logged.

 sarah: end of thread.
